name: com.fidzup.android.cmp.activity.VendorActivity
description: When a user opens a vendor from Fidzup Android CMP's vendor list, this screen shows the vendor's purposes and features. It also opens the vendor's policy when a policy link is available.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from inspecting a vendor's stated purposes and features or reaching its linked policy from Fidzup's interface.
